problem_title: Recurring Fixing/Reparing Potholes — K R Market (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in K R Market between January 2019 and November 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 12% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 88 pothole complaints.
27 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹24.7 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).
Ward recorded 15 road crashes in 2024, of which 0 were fatal.

agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier LOW (score=0.28). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, complaint_volume=0.27, crash_risk=0.15.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='K R Market' matched to datameet243=165 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.665).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for K R Market for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 27 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
